name: Salted Caramel Cups
instructions: Break 1/3 of the chocolate into pieces and slowly melt in a heat resistant bowl placed over a simmering water
Spread 1-2 tsp of chocolate in the bottom of each cupcake liner
Refrigerate for 10 minutes to harden the chocolate
In the meantime, melt remaining chocolate
Dollop 1-2 tsp of the caramel cream on top of the cold chocolate and smooth out
Cover caramel cream with more chocolate and smooth the top
Sprinkle each cup with sea salt and cacao nibs
Refrigerate for 10 minutes or until chocolate has hardened
